decisions.reason: The request transfers a specific NFT or affiliate code to a wallet but does not change the existing rules governing which associated rights and assets follow an NFT transfer.
Changing ownership of code #27 does not alter the commission amount, trigger, distribution, or generic rule that the chosen referrer receives the commission.
The one-off ownership-transfer request neither requests FAQ copy changes nor changes any FAQ-described product rule.
The request concerns ownership of a specified code and does not change commission allocation for missing or rejected referrals.
A specific ownership transfer may affect who satisfies the existing ownership check, but it does not modify the NFT-holder access rule or its contract scope.
The request changes the owner of a specific asset rather than the generic rule for counting successful mints or reporting NFTs from the active contract.
The destination wallet for a specific transfer does not change mobile-wallet ownership-signature or ebook-loading behavior.
The ownership-transfer request is unrelated to Transak payment methods, wallet provisioning, or fiat minting behavior.
The request does not alter mint-success triggers, token identifiers, scenario-specific modal copy, or finalization feedback.
Assigning ownership of code #27 does not change ticket creation or recipient selection for no-referral mints.
The specific code ownership change does not alter coded-referral ticket quantities, triggers, or the generic chosen-referrer allocation rule.
The specific ownership-transfer request does not change the mint price or any founder, affiliate, or prize-pool allocation.
